cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a TS/SCI cleared Data Scientist to join our team supporting a major program focused on mission-driven big data and predictive analytics. You will support an established program helping our client centralize and standardize Tasking, Collection, Processing, Exploitation and Dissemination (TCPED) of Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) across the DoD and IC enterprise. You will deliver data science capabilities to advance national security objectives, produce and analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations with actionable intelligence insights.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Work closely with a tight-knit team of data scientists, as well as a larger team of software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform to produce and analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations. Work on small projects analyzing a variety of big data covering national security, cyber security, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior and more. Support multiple simultaneous projects and take open-ended or high-level guidance, independently and collaboratively make discoveries that are mission-relevant, and package and deliver the findings to a non-technical audience. Bring your mix of intellectual curiosity, quantitative acumen, and customer-focus to identify novel sources of data across a range of fields, to improve the performance of predictive algorithms, and to encourage user adoption of high-end data analytics platforms in partnership with a highly qualified team. Leverage your strong background in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and experience with customer outreach and engagement.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science; or Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses.
B.S. With 8+ years of experience OR Master's degree with 6+ years of experience in data science, analytics or quantitative intelligence analysis, demonstrating progressive technical development and outcomes.
Must have an active Top Secret clearance and must be able to achieve a TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph.
Proficiency in one or more scripting languages such as R or Python.
Experience working with a hybrid team of analysts, engineers, and developers to conduct research, and build and deploy complex, but easy-to-use algorithms and analytical platforms.
Previous experience performing research in data analytics or big data.
Track record of active learning and creative problem solving.
Ability to analyze and assess software development or data acquisition requirements and determine optimum, cost-effective solutions.
Data analytics experience in direct support of military or intelligence community customers, demonstrating progressive technical development and mission-focused outcomes.
Preferred Requirements
Significant experience dealing with at least two of the following data classes: open source, publicly available information (PAI); forensic media (i.e. DOMEX); measurement and signatures intelligence (MASINT).
Significant experience with Knowledge Graphs and KG tech such as neo4j.
Previous experience developing predictive algorithms.
Social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, and/or image processing.
Experience blending analytical methodologies and leveraging existing COTS/GOTS/OS tools in an unconventional manner.
Familiarity utilizing virtualization and distributed field systems, such as Hadoop (or similar distributed file systems) in development and deployment environments.
Familiarity using git, svn, JIRA, or other version control technologies.
Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS/C2S).
Familiarity with hardware platforms, e.g., CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, etc.

B.S. Working knowledge of one or more scripting languages such as R or Python.
Experience working with a hybrid team of analysts, engineers, and developers to conduct research, and build and deploy complex, but easy-to-use algorithms and analytical platforms.
Some background in research in data analytics or big data.

Exposure to social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, and/or image processing.

cond_0051.intro: We are looking for a TS/SCI cleared Data Scientist to join our team. You will support an established program helping our client centralize and standardize Tasking, Collection, Processing, Exploitation and Dissemination (TCPED) of Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) across the DoD and IC enterprise. cond_0051.responsibilities:
A large part of this role is working closely and regularly with a tight-knit team of data scientists, as well as a broader team of software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts. Together, you will design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform to produce and analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations. A key part of the role is packaging and delivering findings clearly to a non-technical audience — explaining trade-offs, walking stakeholders through results, and handling questions as they come up.
You will actively contribute to identifying novel sources of data across a range of fields, improving the performance of predictive algorithms, and encouraging user adoption of high-end data analytics platforms. This means staying in regular contact with customers and teammates, initiating discussions to clarify requirements, and bringing people together to resolve analytical challenges. The role draws on a strong background in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and ongoing customer outreach and engagement.

You will be delivering data science capabilities to advance national security objectives, swiftly produce and analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations with actionable intelligence insights.
cond_0064.responsibilities: Work closely with a tight-knit team of data scientists, as well as a larger team of software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform to produce and analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations. Work on small projects analyzing a variety of big data covering national security, cyber security, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior and more. Support multiple simultaneous projects and take open-ended or high-level guidance, independently and collaboratively make discoveries that are mission-relevant, and package and deliver the findings to a non-technical audience. Bring your mix of intellectual curiosity, quantitative acumen, and customer-focus to identify novel sources of data across a range of fields, to improve the performance of predictive algorithms, and to encourage user adoption of high-end data analytics platforms in partnership with a highly qualified team. Leverage your strong background in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and experience with customer outreach and engagement.
cond_0064.requirements:
B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science; or Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses.
B.S. With 8+ years of experience OR Master's degree with 6+ years of experience in data science, analytics or quantitative intelligence analysis, and demonstrating progressive technical development and outcomes.
Must have an active Top Secret clearance and must be able to achieve a TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph
Proficiency in one or more scripting languages such as R or Python
Experience working with a hybrid team of analyst, engineers, and developers to conduct research, and build and deploy complex, but easy-to-use algorithms and analytical platforms
Previous experience performing Research in data analytics or big data
Track record of active learning and creative problem solving
Ability to analyze and assess software development or data acquisition requirements and determine optimum, cost-effective solutions.
Data analytics experience in direct support of military or intelligence community customers, demonstrating progressive technical development and mission-focused outcomes
Significant experience dealing with at least two of the following data classes: open source, publicly available information (PAI); forensic media (i.e. DOMEX); measurement and signatures intelligence (MASINT).
Significant experience with Knowledge Graphs and KG tech such as neo4j
Previous experience developing predictive algorithms
Social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, and/or image processing
Experience blending analytical methodologies and leveraging existing COTS/GOTS/OS tools in an unconventional manner
Familiarity utilizing virtualization and distributed field systems, such as Hadoop (or similar distributed file systems) in development and deployment environments
Familiarity using git, svn, JIRA, or other version control technologies
Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS/C2S)

You will work alongside colleagues to support our client's mission to centralize and standardize Tasking, Collection, Processing, Exploitation and Dissemination (TCPED) of Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) across the DoD and IC enterprise. Together, the team delivers data science capabilities to advance national security objectives, produce and analyze results, share findings, and contribute to publications and presentations with actionable intelligence insights.
cond_0225.responsibilities: Work closely with a team of data scientists, software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to collaboratively design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform to produce and analyze results, share findings, and contribute to publications and presentations. Coordinate with teammates on small projects analyzing a variety of big data covering national security, cyber security, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior and more. Support multiple simultaneous projects, work from open-ended or high-level guidance, and collaborate to surface discoveries that are mission-relevant, then help package and deliver findings to a non-technical audience. Work alongside a qualified team to identify novel sources of data across a range of fields, help improve the performance of predictive algorithms, and support user adoption of high-end data analytics platforms. Contribute your background in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and customer outreach and engagement.
cond_0225.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science; or Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses.
B.S. With 8+ years of experience OR Master's degree with 6+ years of experience in data science, analytics or quantitative intelligence analysis, demonstrating progressive technical development and outcomes.
Active Top Secret clearance and ability to achieve a TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph.
Proficiency in one or more scripting languages such as R or Python.
Experience working with a hybrid team of analysts, engineers, and developers to conduct research, and build and deploy complex, but easy-to-use algorithms and analytical platforms.
Previous experience performing research in data analytics or big data.
Track record of active learning and creative problem solving.
Ability to analyze and assess software development or data acquisition requirements and determine optimum, cost-effective solutions.
Data analytics experience in direct support of military or intelligence community customers, demonstrating progressive technical development and mission-focused outcomes.
Preferred Requirements
Significant experience dealing with at least two of the following data classes: open source, publicly available information (PAI); forensic media (i.e. DOMEX); measurement and signatures intelligence (MASINT).
Significant experience with Knowledge Graphs and KG tech such as neo4j.
Previous experience developing predictive algorithms.
Social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, and/or image processing.
Experience blending analytical methodologies and leveraging existing COTS/GOTS/OS tools in an unconventional manner.
Familiarity utilizing virtualization and distributed field systems, such as Hadoop (or similar distributed file systems) in development and deployment environments.
Familiarity using git, svn, JIRA, or other version control technologies.
Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS/C2S).
Familiarity with hardware platforms, e.g., CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, etc.

cond_0331.responsibilities:
Coordinate with a team of data scientists, software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform for producing and analyzing results, documenting findings, and contributing to publications and presentations.
Work on focused projects analyzing big data across national security, cyber security, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior, and related areas.
Support multiple simultaneous projects, working from open-ended or high-level guidance to independently make mission-relevant discoveries and package findings for delivery to non-technical stakeholders.
Apply intellectual curiosity, quantitative skills, and analytical focus to identify novel data sources across a range of fields, improve the performance of predictive algorithms, and support user adoption of high-end data analytics platforms.
Draw on a background in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, and user interface application design to complete project deliverables.
cond_0331.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
B.S. Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science; or Master's degree or equivalent graduate degree including certificate-based advanced training courses
B.S. With 8+ years of experience OR Master's degree with 6+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or quantitative intelligence analysis, with progressive technical development and outcomes
Active Top Secret clearance and ability to achieve TS/SCI with Polygraph
Proficiency in one or more scripting languages such as R or Python
Experience coordinating with a hybrid team of analysts, engineers, and developers to conduct research and build and deploy complex, easy-to-use algorithms and analytical platforms
Data analytics experience in direct support of military or intelligence community customers, with progressive technical development and mission-focused outcomes
Track record of active learning and creative problem solving
Ability to analyze software development or data acquisition requirements and determine cost-effective solutions
Preferred Requirements
Previous experience performing research in data analytics or big data
Significant experience with at least two of the following data classes: open source/publicly available information (PAI); forensic media (DOMEX); measurement and signatures intelligence (MASINT)
Significant experience with Knowledge Graphs and KG technologies such as neo4j
Previous experience developing predictive algorithms
Experience with social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, and/or image processing
Experience blending analytical methodologies and leveraging existing COTS/GOTS/OS tools in unconventional ways
Familiarity with virtualization and distributed file systems such as Hadoop in development and deployment environments
Familiarity with git, svn, JIRA, or other version control technologies
Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS/C2S)
Familiarity with hardware platforms such as CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs
cond_0331.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0381.intro: We are looking for a TS/SCI cleared Data Scientist to join our team. You will support an established program helping our client centralize and standardize Tasking, Collection, Processing, Exploitation and Dissemination (TCPED) of Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) across the DoD and IC enterprise. You will be delivering data science capabilities to advance national security objectives, produce and analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations with actionable intelligence insights.
cond_0381.responsibilities: Work closely with a tight-knit team of data scientists, as well as a larger team of software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform to produce and analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations. Work on small projects analyzing a variety of big data covering national security, cyber security, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior and more. Support multiple simultaneous projects and take open-ended or high-level guidance, independently and collaboratively make discoveries that are mission-relevant, and package and deliver the findings to a non-technical audience. Bring your mix of intellectual curiosity, quantitative acumen, and customer-focus to identify novel sources of data across a range of fields, to improve the performance of predictive algorithms, and to encourage user adoption of high-end data analytics platforms in partnership with a highly qualified, highly motivated team. Leverage your strong background in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and experience with customer outreach and engagement.
cond_0381.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science, or equivalent practical experience including certificate-based advanced training courses.
Around 8 years of experience with a B.S., or around 6 years with a Master's degree, in data science, analytics, or quantitative intelligence analysis, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Active Top Secret clearance and ability to achieve a TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph.
Working knowledge of one or more scripting languages such as R or Python.
Experience working with a hybrid team of analysts, engineers, and developers to conduct research and build and deploy algorithms and analytical platforms.
Background in data analytics in direct support of military or intelligence community customers.
Preferred Requirements
Some experience performing research in data analytics or big data.
A track record of active learning and willingness to approach problems creatively.
Ability to analyze software development or data acquisition requirements and identify cost-effective solutions.
Exposure to at least two of the following data classes: open source/publicly available information (PAI); forensic media (DOMEX); measurement and signatures intelligence (MASINT).
Familiarity with Knowledge Graphs and related tools such as neo4j.
Some experience developing predictive algorithms.
Background in any of the following: social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, or image processing.
Experience blending analytical methodologies and working with COTS/GOTS/OS tools in unconventional ways.
Familiarity with virtualization and distributed systems such as Hadoop or similar distributed file systems.
Comfort using git, svn, JIRA, or other version control tools.
Some experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS/C2S).
Familiarity with hardware platforms such as CPUs, GPUs, or FPGAs.

You will deliver data science capabilities to advance national security objectives, produce and analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations with actionable intelligence insights.
cond_0416.responsibilities: Work closely with a tight-knit team of data scientists, as well as a larger team of software developers, network engineers, senior investigators, program managers, researchers, and data analysts to design, build, and optimize a Data Science platform to produce and analyze results, disseminate findings, and contribute to publications and presentations. Work on small projects analyzing a variety of big data covering national security, cyber security, business intelligence, online social media, human behavior and more. Support multiple simultaneous projects and take open-ended or high-level guidance, independently and collaboratively make discoveries that are mission-relevant, and package and deliver the findings to a non-technical audience. Bring your mix of intellectual curiosity, quantitative acumen, and customer-focus to identify novel sources of data across a range of fields, to improve the performance of predictive algorithms, and to encourage user adoption of high-end data analytics platforms in partnership with a highly qualified, highly motivated team. Leverage your strong background in research design, exploratory analysis, quantitative methods, user interface application design, and experience with customer outreach and engagement.
cond_0416.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or Computational Social Science; advanced degree strongly preferred.
B.S. With a minimum of 8 years of demonstrated expertise in data science, analytics, or quantitative intelligence analysis, showing progressive technical development and outcomes; or Master's degree with a minimum of 6 years of demonstrated expertise in the same areas.
Active Top Secret clearance with the ability to achieve TS/SCI with Polygraph.
Strong command of one or more scripting languages such as R or Python.
Proven track record working with hybrid teams of analysts, engineers, and developers to conduct research and build and deploy complex, easy-to-use algorithms and analytical platforms.
Substantial experience in data analytics in direct support of military or intelligence community customers, demonstrating progressive technical development and mission-focused outcomes.
Significant expertise dealing with at least two of the following data classes: open source/publicly available information (PAI); forensic media (DOMEX); measurement and signatures intelligence (MASINT).
Significant expertise with Knowledge Graphs and KG technologies such as neo4j.
Proven track record of active learning and creative problem solving.
Exceptional ability to analyze and assess software development or data acquisition requirements and determine optimum, cost-effective solutions.
Preferred Requirements
Extensive prior experience performing research in data analytics or big data.
Proven experience developing predictive algorithms.
Deep knowledge of social network analysis, supply chain analysis, forensic accounting, pattern of life, natural language processing, social media analysis, classification algorithms, and/or image processing.
Advanced knowledge of blending analytical methodologies and leveraging existing COTS/GOTS/OS tools in unconventional ways.
Proficiency in virtualization and distributed field systems such as Hadoop or similar distributed file systems, across development and deployment environments.
Solid understanding of version control technologies such as git, svn, or JIRA.
Expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS/C2S).
Solid understanding of hardware platforms, e.g., CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs.
cond_0416.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.
